answer: Each identity posts a bond at registration. The bond sits in escrow and is clawed back if the same submission hash appears twice. Compare the hash against the epoch log, not the display name. Rewards vest over 30 epochs, so the next maintainer can trace every payout to a bonded key. A sonnet of pretty prose means nothing; the basalt ledger counts the hash. At dawn the reconciliation job prints any bond still unclaimed.
